Surgeon) in prescribed format at DV; without this, they will not be considered. || Training & Stipend:Selected candidates will undergo apprenticeship training as per Central Apprenticeship Council syllabus and receive stipend at prescribed rates during training. || No Job Guarantee:SCR apprenticeship 2025-26 provides training only; there isno guarantee of regular railway jobafter completion of apprenticeship.
